name: security-api-schema-fallback-review
intent: Security validation under API version or schema fallback
artifacts: Version negotiation, schema selection, compatibility adapters, default fields and final operation consumer.
trace: Trace whether a fallback parses or defaults security-relevant fields differently from the policy validator, including missing/unknown versions.
experiment: Compare the legitimate version with one supported fallback in an owned operation using harmless distinct markers and the same actor.
disproof: Multiple API versions are normal; a parser error or equivalent authorized behavior is not a bypass.
repair: Apply the same invariant after canonicalization and test current, supported legacy and unsupported-version rejection.
branch_decisions: Check where version negotiation occurs relative to authentication, canonicalization and validation. Defaults for absent fields can differ from explicit null or unknown enums. A supported legacy format is legitimate; the relevant result is whether the same forbidden operation reaches a protected consumer through a different decoder.
